card.name: The word if starting a condition
card.fires_on: The word "if" that opens a condition clause right after a phrase like "it is helpful", "do not use it", "except", "as" or "even".

modes.label: After it-is-adjective
modes.description: "if" follows a phrase like "it would be helpful" or "it is acceptable".
modes.example: It is helpful<< if>> the biopsy is done at the same center

modes.label: After an instruction or linking word
modes.description: "if" follows a command, or words like except, as or even, and starts a condition.
modes.example: Do not use it<< if>> it contains particulate matter or if it

card.plain: It fires on the word "if" when it begins a condition, such as "it is helpful if" or "do not use it if".
